name: LEVOCETIRIZINE 5MG 10 TABLETS
description: Levocetirizine is a second-generation antihistamine used to treat allergy symptoms. The 0.5 mg/ml watermelon-flavored solution is especially useful for children, as it is easier to take than tablets. Main uses of levocetirizine Seasonal allergies (hay fever): Relieves symptoms such as sneezing, runny nose, and watery and itchy eyes. Perennial allergies: Treats allergy symptoms that persist year-round, caused by allergens such as dust, mold, or pet dander. Chronic urticaria (hives): Used to relieve itching and the appearance of hives or welts on the skin. Brand names and presentation Some of the brands that offer levocetirizine solution at this concentration in Mexico include: Bocetix: 0.5 mg/ml watermelon-flavored solution, available in a 150 ml bottle. Xuceed: 0.5 mg/ml solution, also available in a 150 ml bottle. Xuzal: A popular brand offering levocetirizine in a children’s solution. Zyxem: Another brand marketed as a 0.5 mg/ml children’s solution. Important Considerations Dosage: The dosage for the 0.5 mg/ml solution is generally 1.25 ml to 2.5 ml once a day for young children. The exact dosage will depend on the patient’s age and the doctor’s recommendation. Sedative Effect: Unlike first-generation antihistamines, levocetirizine causes less drowsiness. However, it can cause sleepiness in some people, so it is recommended to take it at night if this effect is experienced. Prescription Required: Although some over-the-counter antihistamines contain cetirizine, the use of levocetirizine solution usually requires a prescription, especially for children. Interactions and precautions: Talk to your doctor if you are taking other medications that may cause drowsiness or if you have kidney problems. This content is for informational purposes only. For medical advice or diagnosis, consult a healthcare professional. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
